name: relay-work
description: Turn useful ChatGPT conversations into reusable Skills and work you can pick up again.

interface.longDescription:
Turn useful ChatGPT conversations into reusable Skills and work you can pick up again.

Use Make this reusable after useful discussion. ChatGPT proposes general instructions as a standard Agent Skill and instance-specific progress as a work snapshot. Review, edit, save or ignore each independently. Nothing is saved automatically.

In a fresh chat, attach or select your saved Skill/work files and state the new request. Continue using those files without the original conversation. Update saved work and Improve Skill are reviewed separately.

This skills-only plugin uses ChatGPT’s native conversation and file capabilities. It has no custom panel, Relay server, separate Relay account, Relay Desktop requirement, full-history access or cloud synchronization. File creation and selection depend on the host capabilities available in your chat.
defaultPrompt: Make this conversation reusable with Task Relay.
Continue using my selected Skill and saved work.
Update saved work and propose Skill improvements separately.

publication.release_notes: Task Relay uses native ChatGPT conversation and file capabilities. Independently review reusable standard Skills and work snapshots, then select saved files in a new chat to continue. No Relay MCP server, tunnel, account or custom panel is required.
